name: Albany
detailHtml:

The University at Albany and a steady flow of state government business, conferences, and events keep the city busy on weekdays, while downtown's restaurants and the Times Union Center draw evening and weekend crowds.

Because Albany is the hub of the Capital Region, it's also where most of our airport trips start or end — state workers and legislators flying out for business, downtown hotel guests heading to catch a flight, and families picking up relatives arriving at ALB. name: Kingston
detailHtml:
Kingston is the seat of Ulster County and was, briefly, the first capital of New York State — the original state government met here in 1777 before the city was burned by the British that October. Today the Stockade District preserves that colonial-era core, while the Rondout waterfront neighborhood has become a destination for shops, restaurants, and river views.

Kingston sits roughly in between Albany and the New York City airports, so we route trips here either direction depending on the flight — see our Hudson Valley comparison page for which airport usually makes sense. Reliable, 24/7, door-to-door.
